bands.note: clean — the base register establishes the world's normal
first traces: a handful across the whole band, single-element, unattributed
bands.position: early-mid R1, before the Syndicate is named in story

bands.note: a pattern forms near Syndicate business; the decoy's imitation appears
bands.position: mid R1: Syndicate named as an organisation; Jax encountered

bands.note: Class A unlocks at the Syndicate's own seats; density rises toward the seat; the reveal signs the register (name/face admitted on Class A; grammar unchanged)
bands.position: late R1: Veil City approach, Dojo 8

bands.note: Class A follows the Syndicate wherever it operates; the dialect never becomes the game's default skin

laws: no regression of mystery: later bands never explain earlier traces; traces stay deniable after the reveal
the curve is a ceiling, not a quota: bands cap what may appear; an unspent band is lawful, an over-dosed band is a defect

A.dose: full grammar — slants, accent, posed figures, cut-ins, splashes, collage headlines
A.gate: surface record must carry a Syndicate-fiction key or it fails validation
A.name: full dialect
A.who: Mysterious Figure / Luigi and Syndicate surfaces in-fiction: his dialogue scenes, Syndicate encounters/communications, Dojo 8 / Veil City seat surfaces, the reveal sequence, the 8th-dojo battle presentation

B.dose: fragments only over an otherwise base-register screen: slant + one glyph family + at most ONE of {cut-in, splash, collage headline} per surface
B.gate: a Class B surface exceeding the fragment budget fails validation
B.name: high-point fragments
B.who: story high points and major interaction points not owned by the Syndicate: pivotal dialogue beats, legendary-site (peak place-charge) events, Elite/Champion-tier staging, #331 bond-rank threshold scenes (default seat), festival/climax staging

C.dose: single element only; deniable; never attributed in-fiction; no character remarks on a trace
C.gate: a trace carrying attribution (name, face, organisation mark) is a defect, not a trace
C.name: traces
C.who: pre-reveal unattributed intrusions anywhere in the world: a shard tag on ordinary dialogue, one slanted transition, one glyph in a results screen, one message surface in dialect for a single conversation

D.gate: any dialect element on a Class D surface fails validation; this class is the majority of the game by design
D.name: base only
D.who: ordinary play: ordinary dialogue, battles, shops, menus, HUD, garden surfaces

jax.dose: Class B fragment budget, executed one degree off: opposed slant family, accent desaturated one step, poses quoting Class A compositions without completing them
jax.name: the decoy's lesser share
jax.read: a man wearing someone else's style; whether the wrongness is ever named in-fiction is OWNER SLOT 3

composition.calendarArrival: day-arrival splashes (big-numeral title cards) are dialect surfaces: Class A always admitted, Class B on story days, ordinary days arrive in base register; the year itself remains #331's owner/canon slot

dialogue.choices: tilted shards, never a neutral list
dialogue.cutIn: reserved emphasis move; spendable only at Class A/B beats
dialogue.panels: portrait busts in slanted panels; name in a shard tag; opposed speakers take opposed slants
dialogue.unidentifiedSpeaker: tag carries canon's display string only ("Mysterious Figure"); portrait slot is silhouette/shard, never a face; the dialect never leaks a hidden name

composition.figures: full-dialect (Class A) menu surfaces carry a posed character render that changes pose with selection; Mochiichao canon art only
composition.glyphSetNote: production-art slot — a small fixed shard/burst/star-class set in Mochiichao's own style; ships as data when drawn
composition.informationSide: load-bearing information (numbers, names, choices) sits in the mainly-white zone; black/accent zones carry pose, mood, punctuation

palette.accentNote: OWNER SLOT 1 — the dialect's single saturated accent colour is canon, not design; null until ruled
palette.subColourRule: forbidden inside dialect surfaces EXCEPT functional HP/MP-class readouts carried from the base UI (Persona's own exception)

slantFamilies.opposed: reserved for a second speaker/power in split compositions; also the Jax imitation family (see classes.jax)
slantFamilies.primary: one dominant diagonal family per screen

composition.transitions: snap/slide on a beat; held poster-frame splashes sanctioned; slow dissolves off-register

typography.body: standing readable face, always; dialogue lines, stats, body text never collage-treated
typography.labels: collage behaviour permitted (mixed weight/case/rotation) on splashes, section titles, name tags — Mochiichao locked faces only (Bungee/Fredoka per identity kit); no Atlus fonts or assets

dialect.extends: List 34 #331 (mochiichao/bond-rank/v1 + mochiichao/calendar-engine/v1) — presentation layer only; #331 machinery and fences unchanged

dialect.name: Syndicate register
dialect.ownerInFiction: the Syndicate; the leader displayed as "Mysterious Figure" (Luigi Castagnoli, Dojo 8) until the luigi_revealed flag
dialect.sourceGrammar: Persona 5 UI teardown (DOCS/DATA grade; no Persona code or assets) — PERSONA5-UI-TEARDOWN.md beside this file
